rejected_rule.statement: Assets purchased by leasing companies for leasing business constitute capital assets for purposes of taxation.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The Department of Inland Revenue has allowed the depreciation allowance on such lease assets. Hence, the Department of Inland Revenue has confirmed and accepted the fact that, assets purchased by leasing companies for leasing business are 'capital assets' for purposes of taxation.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 61(1)(b) of the Inland Revenue Act No. 10 of 2006
